motion.name: state-ease
motion.purpose: Direct hover, active, and state feedback.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 3rem; padding: .7rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: .5rem; background: var(--accent); color: var(--surface); font: 760 1rem Inter, sans-serif; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1); } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-secondary { min-height: 3rem; padding: .7rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: .5rem; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 720 1rem Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Action
components.description: A 44px disclosure control that remains visually quiet.
components.css: .ds-text-action { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: .65rem .25rem; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--accent); font: 700 1rem Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-text-action:hover { color: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-text-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Band
components.description: Text-plus-color status for validation and recovery.
components.html:
Ready for review

All 11 checks passed. Nothing has been reserved.
components.css: .ds-status { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .85rem; padding: 1.2rem 1.35rem; border: 1px solid oklch(83% .05 151); border-radius: .75rem; background: var(--success-soft); color: var(--ink); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-status p { margin: .2rem 0 0; color: oklch(34% .06 151); font-size: .87rem; } .ds-status-dot { width: .7rem; height: .7rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--success); }

components.name: Authorization Surface
components.description: The only elevated surface, reserved for exact-scope approval.
components.html:
HUMAN AUTHORIZATION

Approve this exact plan

Nothing is reserved until you authorize.
components.css: .ds-authorization { padding: 2.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: .9rem; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 18px 50px oklch(30% .02 70 / .09); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-authorization small { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 760; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-authorization h2 { margin: .55rem 0; } .ds-authorization p { color: var(--muted); }

narrative.overview: Offsite Captain should feel like the clean, annotated run sheet a trusted chief of staff brings into a high-stakes planning meeting. Information is calm and ordered, state changes are explicit, and the plan remains the primary object.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained color with unmistakable semantic states
Explicit separation of proposal, authorization, and reservation

rules.name: The One Decision Rule
rules.body: Terracotta occupies no more than ten percent of a screen and always points to the next consequential action.

rules.name: The Text Plus Color Rule
rules.body: Every semantic color is paired with a title, status message, or state label.

rules.name: The Fixed Product Scale Rule
rules.body: Product headings use fixed rem sizes with one mobile adjustment. Fluid marketing typography is prohibited.

rules.name: The Earned Elevation Rule
rules.body: A surface receives shadow only when its decision weight is greater than its surroundings.

dos: Do make the operating plan the primary object.
Do keep every text action at least 44px high.
Do label proposal, authorization, and reservation as separate states.
donts: Don't use decorative motion or novelty controls.
